title: Risk kernel rejects non-positive quantity before execution

assertions.name: risk rejection status
assertions.expr: isinstance(body, dict) and body.get('status') == 'REJECTED' and body.get('mode') == 'REJECTED'

assertions.name: reject code present
assertions.expr: isinstance(body, dict) and body.get('reject_code') == 'INVALID_QUANTITY' and isinstance(body.get('risk_check_id'), str)
